title: The Rain and the Train
lines: Today is a gray, wet day.
Ray can not play in the rain.
He has to stay in all day.
Then Dad hands him a train set.
Ray paints the train gray and red.
He runs it on the main hall rug.
The rain stops, but Ray will stay in.

questions.ask: Why could Ray not play outside?
questions.listenFor: It was a gray, wet day and it was raining.

questions.ask: What did Ray do with the train set?
questions.listenFor: He painted it gray and red, then ran it on the hall rug.

questions.ask: Why do you think Ray stayed in? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason. He liked the train best.
